Reading in TIF stacks for each cell and creating pixel tables
```{r}
slicenames <- read.csv(paste0(dir, '\\', condcells[1], '_slice_labels.csv'), header = FALSE)[,2]#running ONCE - should be consistent across batch

cells.rasters <- lapply(condcells, function(c){ 
  r <- rast(paste0(dir, '\\', c, '_stack.tif'))
  names(r) <- slicenames
  r <- extend(r, c(1,1), fill = 0)
  crs(r) <- 'local'
  return(r)
})
names(cells.rasters) <- condcells

cells.pixels <- lapply(cells.rasters, function(cr){
  as.data.frame(cr, xy = TRUE)
})
names(cells.pixels) <- condcells
```

MDR analysis - not looped yet
```{r}
#-----extract centroid - nuclei or cell-based------
#nucleus centroid
if('nuclei' %in% slicenames){
  cells.nuc_cent <- do.call(rbind, lapply(condcells, function(c){ 
    p <- pooled_measurements[[c]]@data
    cent <- p[p$Type == 'nuclei', c('X', 'Y')]#should only have one row in pooled measurements - combined centroid if multiples
    cent$condcell <- c
    return(cent)
  }))
} else {#cell centroid
  cells.cell_cent <- do.call(rbind, lapply(condcells, function(c){
    p <- pooled_measurements[[c]]@data
    cent <- p[p$Type == 'cells', c('X', 'Y')]
    cent$condcell <- c
    return(cent)
  }))  
}
#--------------------------

#efficiency - filter down to pixels inside cell boundary
for(name in names(cells.pixels)){
  cells.pixels[[name]] <- cells.pixels[[name]] %>% filter(cell > 0)
}

#-----calculate MDR-----
for(name in names(cells.pixels)){
  cell <- cells.pixels[[name]]
  #distance to nucleus/PM and standard MDR
  dist_angle_to_cent <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:nrow(cell), function(px){ 
    px_x = cell$x[px]
    px_y = cell$y[px]
    if('nuclei' %in% slicenames){ 
      cent <- cells.nuc_cent[cells.nuc_cent$condcell == name,]
    } else {
      cent <- cells.cell_cent[cells.cell_cent$condcell == name,]
    }
    df <- data.frame(
                      dist = abs(sqrt((px_x - cent$X[1])^2 + (px_y - cent$Y[1])^2)),
                      angle = (atan2((px_y - cent$Y[1]), (px_x - cent$X[1]))*180)/pi
    )
    return(df)
  }))
  cell$dist_to_cent <- dist_angle_to_cent$dist
  cell$angle_to_cent <- dist_angle_to_cent$angle
  cr <- subst(cells.rasters[[name]][['cell']], 255, NA)
  cell$dist_to_PM = as.data.frame(mask(distance(cr, exclude = 255), cells.rasters[[name]][['cell']], maskvalues = 0))[,1]#distance to nearest PM pixel (outside cell)
  cell$norm = cell$dist_to_cent/(cell$dist_to_cent + cell$dist_to_PM)
  
  cells.pixels[[name]] <- cell
}

```
